purpose: Final performance record of the MW megakernel before its deletion (C7). After C7 the megakernel cannot be re-measured; this file is the pinned comparator for the wavefront perf gate and for any future archaeology.

hardware.notes: cool GPU (48 C at session start), GPU lock held, isolated process, median-of-5

protocol.harness: median-of-5 interleaved MK/WF timed pairs after 64spp warm of both legs, single process, perf_counter end-to-end around each render call, linear output (applyGamma=False)

cornell_kernel_profile_64spp.note: ASTRORAY_PROFILE=1 per-launch CUDA-event kernel times, same harness as the Phase-A pin (benchmarks/wavefront_baseline.py); compare against the Phase-A baseline.json (pinned 2026-05-17, sha 1a3c159).
cornell_kernel_profile_64spp.interpretation: The megakernel is ~5.7x slower per launch than its Phase-A self (feature cost accreted 2026-05..07: #481 spectral tables, #489/#500 light energy, #490 TLAS, #494 photon hooks, #515 firefly clamp, #519 glass multiscatter LUTs; regs 125->188, past the 158-reg occupancy cliff documented in Phase A). Any 'vs Phase-A baseline' ratio comparison is therefore not meaningful for the C7 gate; the meaningful metric is live WF-vs-MK above.
